Discovery brief: Account security hardening.

Goal: make sign-in safer for our web app.

Item: We want to (a) add rate limiting to the login endpoint so brute-force attempts are throttled, and (b) send the user an email notification when a new device signs in to their account. These are two separable pieces of work that could ship in either order; the rate-limit work touches the auth handler, the notification work touches the mailer.
